goal: Fix the SWA-in-paged bug so TESSERA_PAGED_ATTN produces correct output on SWA models (gemma-4-12B). Unlock S1/S4 on production models.

genes.approach: Fix paged-attn V-transpose mismatch (primary bug) + SWA page-map filter (defensive). Force v_trans=false when TESSERA_PAGED_ATTN+kv_unified; gate paged on !is_v_trans(); filter page-map cells by is_masked_swa against seq_pos_max.
genes.verdict_reason: Fixes the v_trans bug that broke paged on ALL models with -fa off (qwen 1%->100%). gemma-4-12B remains broken via paged due to a separate, pre-existing hybrid-iswa bug that was NOT the SWA issue described in PREFLIGHT.md (gemma fails even with v_trans=false, fa=on, ngl=0, f32 KV, short prompts with no SWA masking active). See best.md for diagnosis.
